item.title: Robots Help Farmers Pick Ripe Fruit
item.description:
Engineers in California have built new autonomous machines.

These specialized robots use computer vision cameras to identify ripe strawberries and apples in the field. "It saves significant labor," said Dr. Smith. The farm owners were very pleased with the initial testing results.
item.author: VOA News
